capabilities: create named, coloured tab groups and expand or collapse them in one click
show a sidebar panel with pinned, ungrouped and external tab sections
shrink pinned tabs to icons while keeping native click behaviours
tint group member tabs with the group colour in light and dark themes
search and filter groups and file names from the panel
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or newer. Data is stored in the plugin's data.json with atomic debounced writes, a rotating backup file, and sync-conflict recovery; the README also states there are no network requests or telemetry, and a Chinese README is available.
motivation: The author juggles research, writing and a project at once and found that finding the right tab cost more than reopening it; groups give the tab bar shape, and persistence was the hard part.
problem: Obsidian's tab bar grows into an unordered queue of open tabs with no way to organise them into groups that survive a restart.
summary: Tab management plugin that adds browser-style named, coloured tab groups with one-click open and collapse, plus a sidebar panel and a compact pinned row.
